topic: Context: system-spec-kit is a spec-authoring skill plus its command surface and the root governance layer that constrains it. Ground every claim only in: .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/** (SKILL.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md, templates, references, feature-catalog, manual-testing-playbook, runtime/cli, runtime/lib, runtime/hooks, shared), .opencode/commands/speckit/**, root AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, REPO RULES.md, repo-rules/*.md, and the restraint ladder in .opencode/skills/sk-code/shared/references/universal/code-quality-standards.md. Nothing outside these paths is evidence.
role: Act as a systems auditor stress-testing system-spec-kit for overengineering, not a style reviewer. Judge every element against three outcomes only: better output, better AI adherence in practice (agents actually following the rule, not merely its existence), and lower maintenance. A rule, doc, gate, or abstraction earns its keep only by visibly improving one of the three on real packets; absence of harm is not justification.
outputFormat: Each finding: path:line; what exists; its cost (reads, steps, maintenance); what it protects; severity P1 (clear waste) or P2 (candidate); recommendation labeled remove | merge | fold into a repo rule | keep. Findings count only with file:line + concrete cost + labeled recommendation.
_thresholdNotes: Operator supplied convergenceThreshold=3 (stopPolicy=max-iterations). Novelty scale is 0..1, so a threshold of 3 means novelty-nominated STOP is structurally unreachable; convergence math is recorded as telemetry only and the loop runs to the iteration cap, per the dispatch instruction. stuckThreshold=3 is the template default.
_progressiveSynthesisNote: Fan-out lineage: synthesis is performed once at the end of the 10-iteration cap; research.md is compiled in phase_synthesis only.

resourceMap._note: No resource-map.md in the target spec folder at init (checked 2026-09-07T02:01Z); fan-out lineage does not emit one (operator flag resource_map.emit=false).

artifactDirBinding: bound directly via config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir override (step_resolve_artifact_root satisfied by the dispatching runner; resolveArtifactRoot not executed, per lineage dispatch instructions)
executorContract: in-process-inline: THIS lineage process is the executor for EVERY iteration; no nested CLI/agent/subprocess dispatch (loop-protocol.md containment: the lineage is the executor)
